# GSAP 3.15.0

`gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js`, `SplitText.min.js` and `Flip.min.js` are the
unmodified browser builds of GSAP 3.15.0 from the `gsap` package on npm.

GSAP and all of its plugins are free to use, including commercially, under the
GreenSock Standard "No Charge" License: https://gsap.com/standard-license

The public homepage loads them from here instead of a CDN, so the page works with
the site's same-origin asset policy and without a third-party request.
